pistas.title: "SKINNY DIPPIN'" • Back Porch Blues Guitar Slide
pistas.description:
🎸 Elevate your guitar skills with exclusive guitar lessons & tips at http://JustinJohnsonGuitar.com Whether you're picking up a guitar for the first time or looking to master advanced techniques, I'll share with you everything I've learned in my guitar journey 🎸

It's been a while since I tuned up the old Mystery Resonator, so I dusted her off, and took her for a spin today with a little laid-back fingerstyle slide blues.  This guitar has the perfect voice for that delta & country blues.  There is something about the aged wood, combined with this particular cone that just barks!  The logo and paint were stripped off years ago, so I don't know what type of guitar it is, but the closest I've been able to find is a Pre-War 30's Dobro... so until I hear different, I'm goin' with that.  

TUNING: Open A (E-A-E-A-C#-E)
GEAR:
• Black Mountain Picks "Jazz Tipped" Thumb Pick (https://blackmountainpicks.com)
• Mystery Resonator (Maybe a Pre-War Dobro?)
• @justinjohnsonlive Signature Ceramic Guitar Slide (https://www.justinjohnsonstore.com)
• CEntrance MixerFace R4R Mobile Recording Interface
• @TELEFUNKENElektroakustik TF 51 Tube Microphone

pistas.title: “SON OF A WITCH” | DARK SWAMP BLUES on the Dobro Duolian Resonator Guitar
pistas.description:
🎸 Elevate your guitar skills with exclusive guitar lessons & tips at http://JustinJohnsonGuitar.com Whether you're picking up a guitar for the first time or looking to master advanced techniques, I'll share with you everything I've learned in my guitar journey 🎸 

⚫️ This track is included on "The Bootleg Series Vol. 3" available at https://justinjohnsonstore.com 

DOWNLOADABLE TABS: https://justinjohnsonstore.com/collections/guitar-instruction/products/guitar-tablature-son-of-a-witch-by-justin-johnson
TUNING: Open D Minor: D-A-D-F-A-D

There's something dark and eerie about the tone of this old Dobro Duolian resonator... it always sounds like it was just pulled out of the swamp.  I picked it up today, and started a slow rhythm on the bass string, with my foot tapping on a tambourine, and this melody began to snake it's way out.
